card.name: Word right before "half-life"
card.fires_on: The word just before "half-life" or "half-lives", such as long, longer, short, plasma, drug or elimination. It fires when the next word is expected to be "half".

modes.label: Qualifier before half-life
modes.description: An adjective like long or longer that describes how long a drug stays in the body, placed before half-life.

modes.label: Noun before half-lives
modes.description: A noun like plasma, drug or elimination that directly precedes half-life or half-lives, often in waiting-period advice.
modes.example: allow at least two to four<< plasma>> half-lives to elapse for the

modes.label: Half before hyphen
modes.description: The word half itself, split before "-lives" after a number.

card.writes: It boosts the word "half" as the next word, as in half-life.
card.plain: It spots the word just before "half-life" and predicts that "half" comes next.
